branching_scalar_collision_witness.method: Exact coefficient and archived-degree arithmetic; no triple enumeration or new samples. Source squares are the sum of squared safe successor counts (safe-pair graph degrees). Triangle=0 uses the existing rank-one black-NN torus bipartite-trigger lemma.
branching_scalar_collision_witness.selection: lexicographically first exact (H2,b2,sum_child_b1_sq) collision with different full clocks; only one such pair in fixed147

new_collision_witness.selection: lexicographically first differing pair among newly evaluated135; fallback all147 only if no such new/new pair
